label: ORCID open letter
description: On 1 January 2016 the first eight publishers sign the open letter and commit to requiring ORCID iDs for corresponding authors; the requirement took effect at eLife on 7 January 2016, at Hindawi on 1 July 2016 and at PLOS on 7 December 2016. Wiley signed in November 2016 and Springer Nature in March 2017.

label: I4OC launched
description: The Initiative for Open Citations is launched on 6 April 2017, asking publishers to open the reference lists they deposit in Crossref.

label: Plan S announced
description: cOAlition S announces Plan S on 4 September 2018: publications under an open licence, preferably CC BY. On 1 August 2018 Crossref releases its Participation Reports in beta.

label: ROR registry launched
description: The first version of the Research Organization Registry is launched in January 2019.

label: Plan S takes effect
description: Plan S applies to publications from grants of cOAlition S members under calls published as of 1 January 2021.

label: References open; CoARA
description: From 3 June 2022 no member of Crossref can limit the distribution of its references. The Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment is constituted on 1 December 2022.

label: JATS 1.4 published
description: JATS 1.4 (ANSI/NISO Z39.96-2024) is published on 31 October 2024. JATS 1.2 can record CRediT roles.
